text:
Priya: Heads up — Acme is aiming to cut over Dedicated pool tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final confirmation on quota, KMS key ARN, IP allowlist, autoscale policy, and warmup run. Who owns which item?
Marco: I can own the load tests and autoscale rules. Which models & peak QPS are we planning for?
Tom: (Acme PM) Mix of chat-7b (low-latency) and summarizer-13b (long ctx). Expect ~220 concurrent users, peak ~600 qps across endpoints. KMS key exists: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/acme-prod-key — will validate.
Lila: For autoscale, recommend target GPU util 65% with scale-up to 90% burst. We also need a KV prefix priming step before ramping real traffic. Suggest a 15m prime + staged ramp.
Priya: @Marco can you propose the ramp and a fallback plan (quantized model fallback) so we have a lat-protection SLO path?
Marco: Draft plan: 0-10m: 50 qps (sanity), 10-25m: 200 qps, 25-40m: 400 qps, 40-55m: 600 qps soak 10m. Fallback: auto-route 95th pct traffic to q7b-quantized if p95 latency > 1200ms for 2 consecutive windows.
Marco: Load test snippet (will commit full script to repo):
```bash
vegeta attack -rate 50 -duration 10m -targets targets.txt | vegeta report -type json > reports/phase1.json
# then ramp by adjusting -rate and targets set
```
Marco: Also will run a KV-priming job to hit common prefixes to warm caches (small payloads, sequenced keys).
Tom: We'll run our harness too. Need IP allowlist for our test runners: 34.210.10.5 and 3.120.88.9. Can you confirm the endpoint hostnames?
Priya: Endpoints: api-dedicated-usw2.redwood-acme.prod and autoscaler hooks are at api-control-usw2.redwood-acme.prod. Add those to the doc.
Lila: I can open a firewall window 08:30–10:30 PT to add allowlist entries. After 10:30 I'll hand to oncall. Also verifying KMS key IAM bindings — need service role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-dedicated-acme.
Priya: Marcus (oncall) — can you take the operational handoff post-warmup?
Marcus: I can. I'll monitor autoscale events, GPU mem pressure, and token errors. If we see error spike > 2% or model OOMs, I'll trigger rollback to hosted fallback.
Tom: Quick ask — can we enable client-side backpressure / retry jitter on our side to avoid synchronized retries during ramp? We'll coordinate with their infra.
Priya: Good idea. Add to checklist. Action items: Marco — load scripts + quantized fallback PR by EOD; Lila — confirm firewall window + autoscale policy by EOD; Tom — confirm KMS IAM role & allowlist ASAP.
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance in us-west-2 on 2026-03-22 07:00 UTC — might overlap warmup window.
Priya: Noted. If overlap occurs we shift cutover. :thumbsup:
Tom: One more — telemetry: please enable extended token/latency traces for first 2 hours so we can correlate client errors.
Marco: Will enable debug traces and keep sampling low to avoid perf hit.
Priya: I'll compile a short go/no-go doc and post link here when ready: https://redwood-internal/ops/go-nogo/acme-cutover. Thanks everyone.
